description: Land Acquisition - Welikada, Sri jayawardhanapura Kotte D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the compulsory acquisition of a specific parcel of land (0.0316 Hectare in Welikada) for a public purpose. The content is exclusively focused on land matters, including the description of the property, its location, and the legal process for claimants to seek compensation. It does not involve government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or any of the other specialized categories.
